title: What is Emergent?
content:
## Welcome to Emergent

Emergent is an **agentic vibecoding platform** where you describe what you want to build in natural language, and AI agents handle the rest—writing code, running tests, and deploying your application.

Instead of writing code line-by-line, you chat with Emergent about your vision. The platform's AI agents translate your intent into working software, manage the technical details, and get your app live.

## How it works

<Steps>
  <Step title="Describe your idea">
    Tell Emergent what you want to build in plain language. No technical knowledge required—just explain the problem you're solving or the experience you want to create.
  </Step>
  
  <Step title="AI agents build it">
    Emergent's agents write the code, set up databases, configure APIs, and handle deployment. They work autonomously, making technical decisions and implementing features based on your description.
  </Step>
  
  <Step title="Test and iterate">
    Review the working app, provide feedback, and refine. The agents respond to your notes and requests, making changes until the app matches your vision.
  </Step>
  
  <Step title="Deploy and scale">
    Your app goes live with hosting, authentication, databases, and infrastructure managed by the platform. Focus on users and features, not DevOps.
  </Step>
</Steps>

## Vibecoding vs. traditional development

<Columns cols={2}>
  <Card title="Traditional coding" icon="code">
    - Write every line of code yourself
    - Configure build tools, dependencies, environments
    - Manually test across devices and scenarios
    - Set up hosting, CI/CD, monitoring
    - Debug infrastructure issues
    - Weeks or months to first version
  </Card>
  
  <Card title="Vibecoding with Emergent" icon="sparkles">
    - Describe what you want in chat
    - AI handles implementation details
    - Automated testing and quality checks
    - Instant deployment and scaling
    - Infrastructure managed for you
    - Working apps in hours or days
  </Card>
</Columns>

<Tip title="Focus on what, not how">
Vibecoding means focusing on *what* you want your app to do, not *how* to implement it. Describe features, user flows, and goals—the agents handle the technical execution.
</Tip>

## What you can build

Emergent supports a wide range of applications, from simple prototypes to production-ready products:

- Mobile and web apps with custom UI/UX
- AI-powered features and workflows
- Database-backed services with authentication
- API integrations and third-party connections
- Media-rich experiences with images, video, and audio

<Info>
Learn more about the types of apps you can create in [What kind of apps you can build?](/what-kind-of-apps-you-can-build)
</Info>

## Built-in capabilities

Emergent provides essential platform features out of the box:

- **[Authentication](/emergent-auth-built-in)** — User sign-up, login, and session management
- **[Database](/database-mongodb)** — MongoDB storage with automatic schema management
- **[AI integrations](/the-universal-llm-key)** — Access to LLMs, image generation, and more
- **[Media generation](/ai-media-generation-image-video-audio)** — Create images, video, and audio with AI
- **[Custom domains](/custom-domain)** — Deploy apps on your own domain
- **[Wingman assistant](/what-is-wingman)** — AI help for users inside your app

</Note>
